title: Oreans two-sample perfect-unpack acceptance gate

pass_rules: candidate_identity must equal the emitted candidate digest/size
protected_identity must equal the locked protected input digest/size
stimuli and observables must be non-empty
every observable verdict must be pass
verdict must be pass and reason must be non-empty

runner_config_digest_contract.per_sample_invariant: for each case_id, runner_config_digest must be present on all ten attempts and all ten values must be exactly identical
runner_config_digest_contract.failure_mode: missing, malformed, or non-uniform values fail closed; a different valid SHA-256-shaped digest on any attempt also fails closed

pass_rules: all ten records are present; missing records open the gate
candidate_sha256 matches the candidate on every attempt
exit_code is 0, signal is absent, and observable_verdict is pass
timestamp is present on every attempt
runner_config_digest is present on every attempt, is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, and is identical across all ten attempts for the same case_id
missing, malformed, or non-uniform runner_config_digest fails closed, including a different valid SHA-256-shaped digest on any attempt
retry_picked is false; a selected retry cannot replace a failed attempt
all non-OEP prerequisite bools must be true
every generic survival/structural evidence ref must have non-empty schema_version, producer, and summary
every generic evidence ref schema_version must exactly equal mida.oreans-prerequisite-evidence/v1
every generic evidence ref artifact_sha256 must be lowercase 64-hex SHA-256-shaped
every generic evidence ref artifact_sha256 must exactly equal the emitted candidate sha256
a caller-supplied survival/structural prerequisite bool cannot pass without its valid candidate-bound evidence ref
structured IAT evidence is validated separately and cannot be replaced by iat_complete or a generic iat_evidence ref
structured OEP evidence is validated separately and cannot be replaced by oep_recovered or a generic oep_evidence ref
prerequisite_evidence_contract.failure_mode: missing, malformed, schema-mismatched, candidate-unbound, or legacy OEP self-certification fails closed and keeps the gate open

binding_rules: protected_input sha256 and size_bytes must match the locked manifest identity
candidate sha256 and size_bytes must match the final serialized candidate observation
rva and final_entry_rva must match the structured PE AddressOfEntryPoint
application_oep must be true, bootstrap_or_ambiguous must be false, and blocker must be null
the acceptance gate recomputes these conditions; sidecar prerequisite_passes is not trusted by itself
structured_oep_evidence_contract.status: implemented and gate-integrated; real sample evidence not produced

structured_pe_evidence_contract.source_of_truth: final serialized candidate PE bytes; SHA-256 and size are computed inside the acceptance kernel
covered: TLS callback VA-to-RVA conversion and null termination
architecture-specific relocation types and in-image targets
x64 RUNTIME_FUNCTION ranges and unwind raw backing
structured_pe_evidence_contract.required_input: structured PE evidence is mandatory for every OreansSampleObservation; missing or invalid evidence fails closed
pass_rules: candidate digest and byte size must be computed from the final serialized candidate bytes and exactly match the observation identity
the candidate must be a valid AMD64 PE32+ image
TLS and base-relocation directories must be present for these samples and their structured detail must be valid
section mappings, directory coverage, and internal PE consistency checks must all pass
when exception data is present, its structured detail must be internally consistent and raw-backed
legacy prerequisite bools and evidence refs cannot substitute for structured PE evidence
structured_pe_evidence_contract.failure_mode: integer overflow, directory/raw-backing gap, unterminated callbacks, invalid relocation, or invalid/unmapped exception record fails closed
structured_pe_evidence_contract.runtime_scope: static bytes only; no sample EXE/live unpack execution
structured_pe_evidence_contract.sample_evidence_status: origin_macro and lunlun_software candidate evidence not yet produced

verdict_contract.isolated_replay_10_of_10_source: ten validated continuous attempt records, not a caller-supplied boolean
verdict_contract.final_behavior_verdict: separate from prerequisites; must be pass
verdict_contract.close_condition: both origin_macro and lunlun_software observations must independently pass structured PE evidence, every other prerequisite, all ten replay attempts, and final behavior evidence
verdict_contract.legacy_oep_self_certification: rejected: oep_recovered and generic oep_evidence refs are not accepted as structured OEP evidence
verdict_contract.structured_oep_evidence: required per sample under mida.oreans-oep-evidence/v1 and independently recomputed by the gate
verdict_contract.structured_iat_evidence: required per sample under mida.oreans-iat-evidence/v1 and independently recomputed by the gate
verdict_contract.structured_tls_evidence: required per sample under mida.oreans-tls-evidence/v1 and independently recomputed by the gate
verdict_contract.structured_relocation_evidence: required per sample under mida.oreans-relocation-evidence/v1 and independently recomputed by the gate
verdict_contract.structured_section_rebuild_evidence: required per sample under mida.oreans-section-rebuild-evidence/v1; final-disk section/header/raw layout is recomputed and cross-checked by the gate

iat_implementation_status.status: Candidate-bound IAT sidecar and structured gate integration are implemented and offline-accepted; real sample evidence has not been produced
iat_implementation_status.scope: observed runtime thunk values are frozen before PASS2 rewrites; rebuilt values are recorded separately; DumpProcessReport returns the report only after the final candidate and manifest are written

notes: This is a gate contract/audit result, not a claim that either sample currently passes.
A structural pass or process survival is only a prerequisite and cannot be reported as final behavior equivalence.
The gate requires exactly origin_macro and lunlun_software; excluded cases cannot fill a missing slot.
The acceptance tests are offline and synthetic; runtime/CLI must produce the behavior and replay records without the acceptance crate executing samples.
The IAT sidecar and structured IAT gate are implemented and offline-accepted, but no real candidate has been generated or accepted for either fixed sample.

recomputed_fail_closed_rules: protected input and final serialized candidate path, SHA-256, and size must match their bound artifacts
fix_imports_requested must be true
iat_evidence_present must equal report presence and iat_evidence_complete must equal structured report completeness
pointer size must match the structured PE PE32+ architecture
each slot must have an exact requested-byte read and requested_bytes must align to slot_size
slot coverage must be complete with continuous, unique slot_index, slot_address, and slot_rva values
slot_value must equal observed_value; stale, unresolved, short-read, and invalid-module statuses fail
resolved slots must carry valid module/function-or-ordinal metadata and at least one resolved slot is required
final imports must be non-empty, slot-unique, ASCII-lowercase by module, and function/ordinal exactly-one
resolved slots and final imports must map one-to-one; module matching is case-insensitive, function matching is exact-case, and ordinals match exactly including 0
diagnostic booleans and blocker fields must agree with the recomputed structured report and cannot self-certify a pass
structured_iat_evidence_contract.status: implemented and offline-accepted; real sample evidence not produced

recomputed_fail_closed_rules: protected_input and candidate SHA-256/size must match their bound observation identities; path fields are diagnostic only
runtime and final pointer size must be exactly 4 or 8 and agree with PE32/PE32+
reported/runtime presence and completeness diagnostics must equal runtime directory_present and blockers.empty
runtime callback slots must be continuous with only Resolved or ZeroTerminator statuses, one final NULL terminator, and no runtime blockers
final TLS directory, raw-data range, index storage, callback list, NULL terminator, zero-fill, and characteristics must be valid and cross-matched with structured PE TLS evidence
final raw-data ranges must be raw-backed by structured PE sections; zero-size ranges are explicitly checked for image bounds
preservation individual fields, all_preserved, and blockers are recomputed from runtime/final values
all blocker vectors must be non-blank, strictly sorted, and deduplicated
sidecar prerequisite_passes and blocker empty/non-empty state must match the final recomputed TLS result
structured_tls_evidence_contract.status: implemented and offline-accepted; real sample evidence not produced

recomputed_fail_closed_rules: protected input and candidate are re-read from disk and bound by SHA-256 and size
same-path and hard-link aliases are rejected and the sidecar is atomically replaced
runtime relocation observations are frozen before header patch, shrink, or relocation-section creation
runtime relocation values are normalized/de-relocated from the runtime image base
final relocation blocks, entries, types, targets, directory raw backing, DYNAMIC_BASE, and RELOCS_STRIPPED are independently checked
every non-ABS relocation target must be individually raw-backed, not merely inside SizeOfImage
ASLR simulation uses normalized values and pure delta arithmetic with distinct positive and negative bases
final fields are cross-checked against OreansPeEvidence.relocation_detail and diagnostic/pass fields are recomputed
structured_relocation_evidence_contract.status: implemented and offline-accepted; real sample evidence not produced

recomputed_fail_closed_rules: protected input and final candidate are re-read from disk and bound by SHA-256 and size
same-path and hard-link aliases are rejected and the sidecar is atomically replaced
unknown sidecar fields are rejected

section table/header coverage, raw and virtual ranges, overlap, EOF, ordering, pointer/size alignment, SizeOfHeaders, SizeOfImage, entry section, executable/raw-backed entry, and overlay extent are independently recomputed
all PE directory coverage is checked, including the security file-offset form, and IAT/TLS/base-relocation/exception ranges are cross-checked against independent evidence
